crossRefs.note: Avoid it, and don’t pass by it. Turn from it, and pass on.
Can a man scoop fire into his lap, and his clothes not be burned?
Or can one walk on hot coals, and his feet not be scorched?
Bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one. For yours is the Kingdom, the power, and the glory…
Have no fellowship with the unfruitful deeds of darkness, but rather even reprove them.

translations.web: Remove your way far from her. Don’t come near the door of her house,
translations.bsb: Keep your path far from her; do not go near the door of her house,
translations.kjv: Remove thy way far from her, and come not nigh the door of her house:
translations.asv: Remove thy way far from her, And come not nigh the door of her house;
